name: Azumi Rui
source:
[b]The Reaper of Black Souls・An Angel of Death[/b]

Age: Probably around 20 years old
Height: About average
Bust: Large

Formally Azrael, the Angel of Death working as a pair with [url=/c166958]Gliere[/url]. 

In order to save [url=/c166953]the protagonist[/url]'s life, she incarnated as a human. Since then, she has been living with him in his office, becoming like an assistant to him and helping him with his investigations. 

She is a kind and cheerful girl.

*Heroine of Vol.1

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1364175/]Getchu[/url]]
